# Rust SDK

* Run build, test, and lint through moon, not cargo directly: `moon run sdk:build`, `moon run sdk:test`, `moon run sdk:lint`, `moon run sdk:fmt`.
* Tests run with `cargo nextest`; doctests run separately with `moon run sdk:test-doc`.
* The toolchain is pinned in `sdk/rust-toolchain.toml`; don't override it.
* New Rust files start with `// Copyright YYYY Adobe. All rights reserved.` using the current year.
* `sdk/core` embeds token and guideline data at compile time. After editing JSON under `packages/design-data/`, run `moon run sdk:codegen`, then `moon run sdk:codegen-check`.
* Never read into `sdk/target/`; it is large and gitignored.
